aufgabe.erklaerung: Ja/Nein-Frage → if/whether; are you → she was.
aufgabe.kontext: Last week a new girl came to our class. On her first day, our teacher asked her a question.

aufgabe.anweisung: Ergänze die Verbformen in der indirekten Rede.
aufgabe.satz: Last Saturday I met my friend Ella in town. She said: "I'm looking for a present for my brother. It's his birthday tomorrow, and I can't find anything nice." Later I told my mum about it. I said that Ella ___ for a present for her brother. I also said that it ___ his birthday the next day and that she ___ anything nice.
aufgabe.erklaerung: am looking → was looking, is → was, can't find → couldn't find.

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze die Verbform der indirekten Rede ein.
aufgabe.satz: Grandma said that she ___ to bake a cake on Sunday.
aufgabe.erklaerung: am going to → was going to.
aufgabe.kontext: Last Monday, Grandma said: "I'm going to bake a cake on Sunday." That Sunday was yesterday.

aufgabe.anweisung: Wähle das passende Verb.
aufgabe.satz: Lisa ___ me that she was late.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Nach dem Verb steht eine Person (me) → told; said steht ohne Person.
aufgabe.kontext: Yesterday Lisa phoned me and said: "I'm late."

aufgabe.anweisung: Finde das falsche Wort und berichtige es.
aufgabe.satz: Last Saturday my brother said that he will clean his room, but he didn't.
aufgabe.erklaerung: will → would: Das Gesagte liegt in der Vergangenheit.

aufgabe.anweisung: Wähle die passende Form.
aufgabe.satz: My cousin said that they ___ into a new flat.
aufgabe.erklaerung: have just moved (present perfect) → had just moved (past perfect); just steht nach had.
aufgabe.kontext: Last Sunday, my cousin said: "We have just moved into a new flat."

aufgabe.anweisung: Letzte Woche sprach Kim über ihr Training. Ordne jeder direkten Rede die indirekte Rede nach „Kim said that she …“ zu.
loesungen: "I've been training for weeks." had been training for weeks. | "I'm training hard." was training hard. | "I'll train tomorrow." would train the next day. | "I can't train today." couldn't train that day.
aufgabe.erklaerung: have been training → had been training, am training → was training, will → would (tomorrow → the next day), can't → couldn't (today → that day).

aufgabe.anweisung: Ist der Satz richtig oder falsch?
aufgabe.satz: Two days after our class trip, Mrs Lee asked us whether we had enjoyed the museum.
loesungen: Two days after our class trip, Mrs Lee asked us whether we had enjoyed the museum.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Richtig: "Did you enjoy the museum?" → whether we had enjoyed the museum.

aufgabe.anweisung: Gestern sagte die Lehrerin zu Ben: "Don't talk during the test!" Kreuze alle richtigen Wiedergaben an.
loesungen: The teacher told Ben not to talk during the test.
The teacher told Ben that he shouldn't talk during the test.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Verneinte Aufforderung: told + Person + not to; auch told Ben that he shouldn't … gibt den Sinn richtig wieder. said und told to passen nicht.
optionen: The teacher told Ben not to talk during the test.
The teacher told Ben don't talk during the test.
The teacher said Ben not to talk during the test.
The teacher told Ben that he shouldn't talk during the test.
The teacher told to Ben not to talk during the test.

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze die Verbform der indirekten Rede ein.
aufgabe.satz: My sister said that she ___ money for a new bike.
aufgabe.erklaerung: am saving → was saving.
aufgabe.kontext: Last month, my sister said: "I'm saving money for a new bike." She bought the bike two weeks ago.

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze die Verbform der indirekten Rede ein.
aufgabe.satz: Oliver said that he ___ to Scotland.
aufgabe.erklaerung: have never been → had never been; inzwischen war er dort, also nur die verschobene Form.
aufgabe.kontext: On Monday, Oliver said: "I've never been to Scotland." On Wednesday, he flew to Scotland with his parents.

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze die Verbform der indirekten Rede ein.
aufgabe.satz: Holly said that she ___ me when she got home.
aufgabe.erklaerung: will text → would text.
aufgabe.kontext: Last week, Holly said: "I'll text you when I get home." But she forgot.

aufgabe.anweisung: Gib die Frage wieder. Beginne mit „Our teacher asked Amir“.
aufgabe.satz: Our teacher: "Why are you late, Amir?"
loesungen: Our teacher asked Amir why he was late.
aufgabe.erklaerung: W-Frage: why + Aussagestellung; are you → he was.
aufgabe.kontext: Last Monday, Amir arrived at school twenty minutes late.

aufgabe.anweisung: Gib wieder, was Mr Fox gesagt hat. Beginne mit „Mr Fox told me“.
aufgabe.satz: Mr Fox: "I'm going to sell my car because I don't need it any more."
loesungen: Mr Fox told me that he was going to sell his car because he didn't need it any more.
Mr Fox told me he was going to sell his car because he didn't need it any more.
Mr Fox told me that he was going to sell his car because he did not need it any more.
Mr Fox told me he was going to sell his car because he did not need it any more.
aufgabe.erklaerung: am going to → was going to, don't need → didn't need; I → he, my → his.
aufgabe.kontext: Last spring, our neighbour Mr Fox talked to me in the garden. He sold his car in May.

aufgabe.anweisung: Ergänze die Verbformen in der indirekten Rede.
aufgabe.satz: Last Friday my best friend Chloe sent me a message: "I can't come to the cinema tonight. My mum has asked me to look after my little brother. I'll call you tomorrow!" When my parents asked me why I was at home on Friday evening, I explained that Chloe ___ to the cinema. I told them that her mum ___ her to look after her little brother and that she ___ me the next day.
loesungen: couldn't come | had asked | would call
aufgabe.erklaerung: can't → couldn't, has asked → had asked, will → would (tomorrow → the next day).

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze die Form der indirekten Rede ein.
aufgabe.satz: The doctor told my grandpa that he ___ for thirty minutes every day.
aufgabe.erklaerung: must → had to; must darf in der indirekten Rede auch bleiben.
aufgabe.kontext: Last week the doctor said to my grandpa: "You must walk for thirty minutes every day."

aufgabe.anweisung: Was wird aus dem Verb, wenn man den Satz später nach „He said that …“ wiedergibt? Ordne zu.
loesungen: had + 3. Form: "I've broken my arm.", "She has left the party." | would + Grundform: "We'll be late.", "I'll help you." | was/were + -ing: "I'm cooking dinner.", "They're sleeping."
aufgabe.erklaerung: present perfect → had + 3. Form, will → would, present progressive → was/were + -ing.

elemente.text: "I've broken my arm."
"We'll be late."
"I'm cooking dinner."
"She has left the party."
"I'll help you."
"They're sleeping."

aufgabe.anweisung: Finde das falsche Wort und berichtige es.
aufgabe.satz: The day before the maths test, my friend asked me if I can help her, so I went to her house after school.
aufgabe.erklaerung: "Can you help me?" → she asked me if I could help her.

aufgabe.anweisung: Was wird aus der Verbform in der indirekten Rede nach „He said that he …“? Ordne zu.
loesungen: "I have finished." had finished | "I will finish." would finish | "I can finish." could finish | "I am finishing." was finishing | "I have been waiting." had been waiting
aufgabe.erklaerung: Jede Zeitform rückt eine Stufe zurück: have finished → had finished, will → would, can → could, am finishing → was finishing, have been waiting → had been waiting.

aufgabe.anweisung: Ist der Satz richtig oder falsch? Wenn er falsch ist, berichtige das falsche Wort.
aufgabe.satz: At the party two weeks ago, Ben said that he will call me the next day, but he never did.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Falsch: Der Anruf sollte am Tag nach der Party sein, das ist vorbei → will wird zu would.

aufgabe.anweisung: Vor zwei Wochen sagte Lea: "I'm going to visit my grandma on Sunday because I haven't seen her for months." Der Sonntag ist inzwischen vorbei. Kreuze alle richtigen Wiedergaben an.
loesungen: Lea said that she was going to visit her grandma on Sunday because she hadn't seen her for months.
Lea said she was going to visit her grandma on Sunday because she hadn't seen her for months.
aufgabe.erklaerung: am going → was going, haven't seen → hadn't seen; that darf fehlen. told braucht ein Objekt (told me), und didn't see passt nicht zu for months.
optionen: Lea said that she was going to visit her grandma on Sunday because she hadn't seen her for months.
Lea said that she is going to visit her grandma on Sunday because she haven't seen her for months.
Lea said she was going to visit her grandma on Sunday because she hadn't seen her for months.
Lea said that she was going to visit her grandma on Sunday because she didn't see her for months.
Lea told that she was going to visit her grandma on Sunday because she hadn't seen her for months.

aufgabe.anweisung: Wähle die passende Form.
aufgabe.satz: Tom said that they ___ the following month.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Der Umzug ist vorbei: present progressive (are moving) → past progressive (were moving).
aufgabe.kontext: Last summer, Tom's family was planning to move to Scotland. Tom told us: "We're moving next month." They moved in August.

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze die Verbform der indirekten Rede ein.
aufgabe.satz: Our coach said that the team ___ really well that season.
aufgabe.erklaerung: has played (present perfect) → had played (past perfect).
aufgabe.kontext: At the end of last season, our coach said: "The team has played really well this season."

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze die Verbform der indirekten Rede ein.
aufgabe.satz: Emma said that she ___ the book before the holidays, but she didn't.
aufgabe.erklaerung: will finish → would finish.
aufgabe.kontext: In June, Emma said: "I will finish the book before the holidays." The holidays are over now.

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze die Verbform der indirekten Rede ein.
aufgabe.satz: Mia told her teacher that she ___ her bag on the bus.
aufgabe.erklaerung: simple past → past perfect (had lost); hier ist auch lost ohne Verschiebung richtig, weil die Reihenfolge klar ist.
aufgabe.kontext: Last Monday, Mia told her teacher: "I lost my bag on the bus this morning."

aufgabe.anweisung: Gib die Frage in der indirekten Rede wieder. Beginne mit „The boss asked Ryan“.
aufgabe.satz: The boss: "How long have you been working in a restaurant?"
loesungen: The boss asked Ryan how long he had been working in a restaurant.
The boss asked Ryan how long he'd been working in a restaurant.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Indirekte Frage: Fragewort + Aussagestellung (he had been working), have been working → had been working, you → he.
aufgabe.kontext: Last week, Ryan asked for a summer job in a restaurant.

aufgabe.anweisung: Gib wieder, was Lisa gesagt hat. Beginne mit „Lisa told her friends“.
aufgabe.satz: Lisa: "I'm going to miss you, but I'll visit you as often as I can."
loesungen: Lisa told her friends that she was going to miss them, but she would visit them as often as she could.
Lisa told her friends she was going to miss them, but she would visit them as often as she could.
Lisa told her friends that she was going to miss them, but she'd visit them as often as she could.
Lisa told her friends she was going to miss them, but she'd visit them as often as she could.
Lisa told her friends that she was going to miss them, but that she would visit them as often as she could.
Lisa told her friends she was going to miss them, but that she would visit them as often as she could.
aufgabe.erklaerung: am going → was going, will → would, can → could; you → them, I → she.
aufgabe.kontext: Lisa moved to Australia last year. Before she left, she said goodbye to her friends.

aufgabe.anweisung: Ergänze die Verbformen in der indirekten Rede.
aufgabe.satz: Two years ago, I wrote an article about our old neighbour, Mr Hughes, for the school magazine. He has since moved to Scotland to live with his daughter. When I visited him, he told me: "I have lived in this street for fifty years. I worked at the old station for most of my life. Next year I will be ninety, and I am planning a big party." In my article, I wrote that Mr Hughes ___ in our street for fifty years and that he ___ at the old station for most of his life. He also said that he ___ ninety the following year and that he ___ a big party.
loesungen: had lived | had worked | would be | was planning
aufgabe.erklaerung: have lived → had lived, worked → had worked (oder worked), will be → would be, am planning → was planning.

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze die Form der indirekten Rede ein.
aufgabe.satz: Jake's mum told him that he ___ his room before his friends arrived.
aufgabe.erklaerung: must → had to; must darf in der indirekten Rede auch stehen bleiben.
aufgabe.kontext: Last Thursday, Jake's mum said to him: "You must tidy your room before your friends arrive."

aufgabe.anweisung: Lena sprach letzte Woche. Ordne jeder direkten Rede die richtige indirekte Rede nach „Lena said that …“ zu.
loesungen: "I'm working in the garden." she was working in the garden. | "I've been working in the garden." she had been working in the garden. | "I'll work in the garden." she would work in the garden. | "I can work in the garden." she could work in the garden.
aufgabe.erklaerung: am working → was working, have been working → had been working, will → would, can → could.

paare.rechts: she was working in the garden.
she had been working in the garden.
she would work in the garden.
she could work in the garden.

aufgabe.anweisung: Finde das falsche Wort und berichtige es.
aufgabe.satz: When I spoke to Kevin after the match on Sunday, he said that he has never played such a bad match before.
aufgabe.erklaerung: "I have never played …" → he had never played (present perfect → past perfect).

aufgabe.anweisung: Wähle das passende Verb.
aufgabe.satz: Emma ___ me that she had lost the key to her bike.
aufgabe.erklaerung: tell braucht eine Person direkt danach (told me); say steht ohne Person (said that …).

aufgabe.anweisung: Ordne jeder direkten Rede die passende indirekte Rede zu.
loesungen: Jack: "I'm hungry." Jack said that he was hungry. | Jack: "I was hungry." Jack said that he had been hungry. | Jack: "I'll be hungry." Jack said that he would be hungry. | Jack: "I can cook." Jack said that he could cook.
aufgabe.erklaerung: am → was, was → had been, will → would, can → could.

paare.rechts: Jack said that he was hungry.
Jack said that he had been hungry.
Jack said that he would be hungry.
Jack said that he could cook.

aufgabe.anweisung: Ist der Satz richtig oder falsch? Wenn er falsch ist, berichtige das falsche Wort.
aufgabe.satz: Tom said me that he was too tired to play football after school.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Falsch: Mit Person danach heißt es told me, nicht said me.

aufgabe.anweisung: Sortiere die direkten Fragen: Brauchst du in der indirekten Frage if/whether oder bleibt das Fragewort?
loesungen: if/whether: Are you hungry?, Do you like football?, Have you finished your story? | Fragewort bleibt: Where do you live?, Why are you late?, What did you buy in town?
aufgabe.erklaerung: Ja/Nein-Fragen werden mit if/whether wiedergegeben, W-Fragen behalten ihr Fragewort.

elemente.text: Are you hungry?
Do you like football?
Have you finished your story?
Where do you live?
Why are you late?
What did you buy in town?

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze das Verb in der indirekten Rede ein.
aufgabe.satz: Tom said that he ___ too tired to go to the party.
aufgabe.erklaerung: simple present (am) → simple past (was).
aufgabe.kontext: Tom: "I am too tired to go to the party."

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze das Verb in der indirekten Rede ein.
aufgabe.satz: Anna said that she ___ her phone on the bus.
aufgabe.erklaerung: present perfect (have lost) → past perfect (had lost).
aufgabe.kontext: Anna: "I have lost my phone on the bus."

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze das Verb in der indirekten Rede ein.
aufgabe.satz: Ben said that he ___ me with my homework the next day.
aufgabe.erklaerung: will help → would help.
aufgabe.kontext: Ben: "I will help you with your homework tomorrow."

aufgabe.anweisung: Gib die Frage in indirekter Rede wieder.
aufgabe.satz: "Where do you live?" Ella asked me.
loesungen: Ella asked me where I lived.
Ella asked me where I live.
aufgabe.erklaerung: W-Frage: Fragewort + Subjekt + Verb, ohne do; live → lived.

aufgabe.anweisung: Ergänze den Bericht in indirekter Rede. Bilde die Formen aus den Verben in Klammern.
aufgabe.satz: Yesterday I met my old friend Sam in town. He told me that he ___ in Manchester now. He said that he ___ a new job two weeks before. I asked him if he ___ his new flat, and he said it was great. When we said goodbye, he promised that he ___ me again the following month.
loesungen: lived | had started | liked | would visit
aufgabe.erklaerung: live → lived, started → had started, like → liked, will visit → would visit.
aufgabe.kontext: Sam: "I live in Manchester now. I started a new job two weeks ago." – "Do you like your new flat?" – "Yes, it's great. I'll visit you again next month."

aufgabe.anweisung: Wähle die passende Zeitangabe.
aufgabe.satz: On Monday Lucy told me that she was going to the dentist ___.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Ein anderer Tag: tomorrow → the next day.
aufgabe.kontext: On Monday Lucy said to you: "I'm going to the dentist tomorrow." Now it is Wednesday and you tell a friend about it.

aufgabe.anweisung: Gib die Frage in indirekter Rede wieder.
aufgabe.satz: "Have you finished your homework?" Dad asked me.
loesungen: Dad asked me if I had finished my homework.
Dad asked me whether I had finished my homework.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Ja/Nein-Frage → if/whether; present perfect → past perfect; you/your → I/my.

aufgabe.anweisung: Wähle das passende Verb.
aufgabe.satz: Lily ___ that she was too tired to go out with us.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Ohne Person danach: said that; told braucht eine Person (told us), asked passt nicht zu einer Aussage.

aufgabe.anweisung: Finde das falsche Wort und berichtige es.
aufgabe.satz: Anna said that she will come to my party the next day.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Nach said wird will zu would.

aufgabe.anweisung: Wähle die richtige Fortsetzung.
aufgabe.satz: My cousin asked me ___.
loesungen: where I had bought my new jacket
optionen: where I had bought my new jacket
where had I bought my new jacket
where did I buy my new jacket
where I have bought my new jacket
aufgabe.erklaerung: Indirekte W-Frage: Subjekt vor dem Verb, kein did; simple past → past perfect.
aufgabe.kontext: My cousin: "Where did you buy your new jacket?"

aufgabe.anweisung: Ordne jeder Angabe aus der direkten Rede die passende Angabe in der indirekten Rede zu.
loesungen: today that day | tomorrow the next day | yesterday the day before | here there | two weeks ago two weeks before
aufgabe.erklaerung: Wird später oder an einem anderen Ort berichtet, verschieben sich Zeit- und Ortsangaben.

aufgabe.anweisung: Sortiere: Musst du in der indirekten Rede die Zeit zurückverschieben oder nicht?
loesungen: Zeitverschiebung nötig: She said: "I'm hungry.", He told me: "I'll be late.", They said: "We have finished." | keine Zeitverschiebung nötig: She says: "I'm hungry.", He tells me: "I'll be late.", Our teacher said: "The Earth goes around the sun."
aufgabe.erklaerung: Zurückverschoben wird nach says/tells nicht; bei allgemeingültigen Tatsachen ist es nicht nötig. Nach said/told dagegen schon.

elemente.text: She said: "I'm hungry."
He told me: "I'll be late."
They said: "We have finished."
She says: "I'm hungry."
He tells me: "I'll be late."
Our teacher said: "The Earth goes around the sun."

aufgabe.anweisung: Ist der Satz richtig oder falsch? Wenn er falsch ist, berichtige das falsche Wort.
aufgabe.satz: Our neighbour told that she had seen a big black dog in our garden the night before.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Falsch: Ohne Person danach heißt es said that; told braucht eine Person (told us).

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze das Verb in der indirekten Rede ein.
aufgabe.satz: Leo told us that he ___ a famous actor at the station.
aufgabe.erklaerung: simple past (saw) → past perfect (had seen).
aufgabe.kontext: Leo: "I saw a famous actor at the station."

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze das Modalverb und das Verb in der indirekten Rede ein.
aufgabe.satz: Mrs Hill told us that we ___ a dictionary.
aufgabe.erklaerung: can → could, weil der Test vorbei ist.
aufgabe.kontext: Before yesterday's English test, Mrs Hill said: "You can use a dictionary."

aufgabe.anweisung: Gib die Frage in indirekter Rede wieder.
aufgabe.satz: "Why are you crying?" the old lady asked the little boy.
loesungen: The old lady asked the little boy why he was crying.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Fragewort + Subjekt + Verb; are → was, you → he.
aufgabe.anfang: The old lady asked the little boy

aufgabe.anweisung: Bilde aus den Teilen eine indirekte Frage.
loesungen: She wanted to know if I had ever been to Scotland.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Indirekte Ja/Nein-Frage: if + Subjekt + Verb (I had ever been), keine Frage-Wortstellung.

aufgabe.anweisung: Ergänze den Bericht. Bilde die Verbformen aus den Wörtern in Klammern bzw. wähle das passende Verb.
aufgabe.satz: Yesterday our class teacher, Mr Green, ___ us some big news. He said that he ___ our school at the end of the year because he ___ a new job in Scotland. Some students asked him why he ___ to go so far away. He explained that his wife's family lived there. At the end of the lesson he ___ us not to be sad.
loesungen: told | was leaving | had found | wanted | told
aufgabe.erklaerung: told + Person; Zukunft → was leaving/would leave; has found → had found; indirekte Frage why he wanted; Aufforderung told us not to …
aufgabe.kontext: Mr Green: "I am leaving the school at the end of the year because I have found a new job in Scotland." Students: "Why do you want to go so far away?"

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze das Verb in der indirekten Rede ein.
aufgabe.satz: When Chloe finally got to school, she told us that she ___ for the bus for forty minutes.
aufgabe.erklaerung: present perfect progressive → past perfect progressive (had been waiting).
aufgabe.kontext: Chloe at the bus stop: "I have been waiting for the bus for forty minutes!"

aufgabe.anweisung: Gib die Frage in indirekter Rede wieder.
aufgabe.satz: "Are you travelling alone?"
loesungen: The officer asked Jack if he was travelling alone.
The officer asked Jack whether he was travelling alone.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Ja/Nein-Frage → if/whether + Subjekt + Verb; are travelling → was travelling.
aufgabe.kontext: At the airport an officer asked Jack a question.

aufgabe.anweisung: Wähle das passende Wort.
aufgabe.satz: My friend wanted to know ___ I was coming to the cinema with them on Friday.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Indirekte Ja/Nein-Frage → if (oder whether); that leitet Aussagen ein.

aufgabe.anweisung: Ist der Satz richtig oder falsch?
aufgabe.satz: In the science lesson our teacher explained that light travels faster than sound.
loesungen: In the science lesson our teacher explained that light travels faster than sound.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Richtig: Eine allgemeingültige Tatsache muss nicht zurückverschoben werden.

aufgabe.anweisung: Du bist inzwischen umgezogen und erzählst von Rubys Frage. Wähle den richtigen Satz.
loesungen: Ruby asked me whether I would still be living there the following year.
optionen: Ruby asked me whether I would still be living there the following year.
Ruby asked me whether would I still be living there the following year.
Ruby asked me whether I will still be living here the following year.
Ruby asked me that I would still be living there the following year.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Ja/Nein-Frage → whether + Aussage-Wortstellung; will → would; here → there, next year → the following year.
aufgabe.kontext: Last year Ruby asked you: "Will you still be living here next year?"

aufgabe.anweisung: Ordne jedem Modalverb der direkten Rede seine Form in der indirekten Rede (nach said/told) zu.
loesungen: "You must leave now." … that we had to leave then. | "You can leave now." … that we could leave then. | "You will leave tomorrow." … that we would leave the next day. | "You should leave now." … that we should leave then.
aufgabe.erklaerung: must → had to, can → could, will → would; should bleibt unverändert.

paare.rechts: … that we had to leave then.
… that we would leave the next day.

aufgabe.anweisung: Ist der Satz richtig oder falsch? Wenn er falsch ist, berichtige das falsche Wort.
aufgabe.satz: When I met my old friend last month, she told me that she has moved to the city the year before.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Falsch: Nach told und mit the year before steht past perfect – had moved.

aufgabe.anweisung: Ruby fragte dich: "Did you watch the match last night?" Eine Woche später erzählst du davon. Wähle alle richtigen Wiedergaben.
loesungen: Ruby asked me if I had watched the match the night before.
Ruby asked me whether I had watched the match the night before.
aufgabe.erklaerung: if/whether + Aussage-Wortstellung; watched → had watched; eine Woche später wird last night zu the night before.
optionen: Ruby asked me if I had watched the match the night before.
Ruby asked me whether I had watched the match the night before.
Ruby asked me if I had watched the match last night.
Ruby asked me if had I watched the match the night before.
Ruby asked me did I watch the match the night before.

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze die Verbform in der indirekten Rede ein.
aufgabe.satz: Ethan told me that he ___ abroad before he went to Scotland the summer before.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Past perfect kann nicht weiter zurück – es bleibt had never been.
aufgabe.kontext: Ethan: "I had never been abroad before I went to Scotland last summer."

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze die Verbform in der indirekten Rede ein.
aufgabe.satz: The coach told us that we ___ our own water, so I packed two big bottles.
aufgabe.erklaerung: must (Pflicht) wird meist zu had to; must darf auch stehen bleiben.
aufgabe.kontext: Before the trip, the coach said: "You must bring your own water."

aufgabe.anweisung: Gib die Frage in indirekter Rede wieder.
aufgabe.satz: "Where can I buy a ticket for this bus?" the tourist asked me.
loesungen: The tourist asked me where he could buy a ticket for that bus.
The tourist asked me where she could buy a ticket for that bus.
The tourist asked me where they could buy a ticket for that bus.
The tourist asked me where he could buy a ticket for the bus.
The tourist asked me where she could buy a ticket for the bus.
The tourist asked me where they could buy a ticket for the bus.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Fragewort + Subjekt + Verb; can → could, I → he/she, this → that.

aufgabe.anweisung: Bilde aus den Teilen eine indirekte Frage.
loesungen: The reporter wanted to know whether the new stadium would be finished in time.
aufgabe.erklaerung: whether + Subjekt + Verb (the new stadium would be finished) – keine Frage-Wortstellung.

aufgabe.anweisung: Gib die Frage in indirekter Rede wieder.
aufgabe.satz: "What were you doing when the fire alarm went off?" the head teacher asked the students.
loesungen: The head teacher asked the students what they had been doing when the fire alarm went off.
The head teacher asked the students what they had been doing when the fire alarm had gone off.
The head teacher asked the students what they were doing when the fire alarm went off.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Fragewort + Subjekt + Verb; were doing → had been doing (im Zeitsatz darf went off bleiben).
aufgabe.anfang: The head teacher asked the students

aufgabe.anweisung: Gib Joshs Aussage am nächsten Tag in indirekter Rede wieder.
aufgabe.satz: "I won't come to training today."
loesungen: Josh told me that he wouldn't come to training that day.
Josh told me he wouldn't come to training that day.
Josh told me that he would not come to training that day.
Josh told me he would not come to training that day.
Josh told me that he wouldn't come to training on Monday.
Josh told me he wouldn't come to training on Monday.
Josh told me that he would not come to training on Monday.
Josh told me he would not come to training on Monday.
aufgabe.erklaerung: won't → wouldn't, I → he, today → that day.
aufgabe.kontext: Josh phoned me on Monday morning. On Tuesday you tell the coach about it.

aufgabe.anweisung: Gib die Anweisung als Aufforderung in indirekter Rede wieder.
aufgabe.satz: "Don't open the door to anyone while I'm out," Mum said to my little brother.
loesungen: Mum told my little brother not to open the door to anyone while she was out.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Verbot → told + Person + not to + Grundform; I'm out → she was out.

aufgabe.anweisung: Wähle die passende Verbform.
aufgabe.satz: My brother has just told me that he ___ to the shop and asked if I needed anything.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Einleitungsverb im present perfect (has just told) und die Sache ist noch aktuell → keine Zeitverschiebung: is going.
aufgabe.kontext: A minute ago my brother said: "I'm going to the shop." He is still putting on his shoes.

aufgabe.anweisung: Finde das falsche Wort und berichtige es.
aufgabe.satz: At the meeting last week, the head teacher explained that the school would get new computers and that the old ones are going to be given to a local charity the following month.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Auch der zweite that-Satz wird verschoben (the following month zeigt den späteren Bericht): are going to → were going to.

aufgabe.anweisung: Wähle die richtige Form.
aufgabe.satz: I think Mia ___ the race.
aufgabe.erklaerung: will ändert sich nie, danach steht die Grundform: will win.

aufgabe.anweisung: Ist der Satz richtig oder falsch?
aufgabe.satz: Max will probably be late again.
loesungen: Max will probably be late again.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Richtig: probably steht nach will, dann kommt die Grundform be.

aufgabe.anweisung: Was glaubst du? Setze will und das Verb ein.
aufgabe.satz: I think it ___ sunny tomorrow.
aufgabe.erklaerung: I think → Vermutung mit will: will be.

aufgabe.anweisung: Bilde einen Satz mit probably.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Bei der Verneinung steht probably vor won't.

aufgabe.anweisung: Was glaubt Mia? Setze will und das Verb ein.
aufgabe.satz: Mia says, "I think she ___ better tomorrow."
aufgabe.erklaerung: I think → Vermutung mit will: will be.
aufgabe.kontext: Mia's grandma is sick today.

aufgabe.anweisung: Anzeichen oder Meinung? Wähle die passende Form.
aufgabe.satz: Look at those black clouds! It ___.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Du siehst die Wolken schon (Look!) → Anzeichen → going to.

aufgabe.anweisung: Wähle die richtige Form.
aufgabe.satz: I don't think it ___ tomorrow, so let's go to the beach.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Nach I don't think steht will ohne not – die Verneinung steckt schon in don't.

aufgabe.anweisung: Ordne jedem Satz die passende Bedeutung zu.
loesungen: Look at those black clouds! It's going to rain. Vorhersage mit Anzeichen | I think it'll be sunny on Sunday. Vorhersage als Meinung | We're going to watch the match on Saturday. We've already bought the tickets. Plan | "I'm hungry." – "I'll make you something to eat." spontane Entscheidung
aufgabe.erklaerung: Meinung (I think) und spontane Entscheidung → will; Anzeichen (Look!) und Plan → going to.

paare.links: Look at those black clouds! It's going to rain.
I think it'll be sunny on Sunday.
We're going to watch the match on Saturday. We've already bought the tickets.
"I'm hungry." – "I'll make you something to eat."

aufgabe.anweisung: Ist der Satz richtig oder falsch?
aufgabe.satz: I'm sure you'll enjoy the trip – it's always great fun.
loesungen: I'm sure you'll enjoy the trip – it's always great fun.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Richtig: I'm sure + will ('ll) + Grundform enjoy.

aufgabe.anweisung: Welche Sätze sind richtig? Kreuze alle richtigen an.
loesungen: She will probably win the race.
I don't think she will lose.
aufgabe.erklaerung: probably steht nach will/'ll und vor der Grundform; nach I don't think steht will ohne not.
optionen: She will probably win the race.
She will be probably the winner.
I don't think she will lose.

aufgabe.anweisung: Was glaubst du? Setze will und das Verb ein.
aufgabe.satz: I think Jack ___ my new computer game. He loves games.
aufgabe.erklaerung: I think → Vermutung mit will: will like.

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze will, probably und das Verb ein.
aufgabe.satz: Our bus is often late, so we ___ the start of the film.
aufgabe.erklaerung: probably steht nach will: will probably miss.

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze will, probably und das Verb verneint ein.
aufgabe.satz: It's very cold, so the children ___ outside today.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Bei der Verneinung steht probably vor won't: probably won't play.

aufgabe.anweisung: Bilde einen Satz mit probably.
loesungen: Our teacher probably won't give us homework today.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Bei der Verneinung steht probably vor won't.

aufgabe.anweisung: Was sagt Mum? Setze will und das Verb ein.
aufgabe.satz: His mum says, "Don't worry. I'm sure it ___ fine."
aufgabe.erklaerung: I'm sure → Meinung über die Zukunft mit will: will be.
aufgabe.kontext: Sam's English test is tomorrow, and he is nervous. He has learned a lot.

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze will oder going to mit dem Verb ein. Meinung/Vermutung (I think, I'm sure, probably) → will; sichtbares Anzeichen → going to.
aufgabe.satz:
Mum: Are you ready for the trip to the lake?
Leo: Yes! I think it ___ (be) a great day.
Mum: Oh, look at those black clouds over the lake! It ___ (rain).
Leo: Oh no. Then we ___ (probably / not / swim).
Mum: Don't be sad. I'm sure you ___ (enjoy) the museum.
loesungen: will be | is going to rain | probably won't swim | will enjoy
aufgabe.erklaerung: I think / I'm sure / probably → will; Look at those clouds! → going to.

aufgabe.anweisung: Anzeichen oder Meinung? Wähle die passende Form.
aufgabe.satz: Look! That tree ___ over!
aufgabe.erklaerung: Man sieht das Anzeichen schon jetzt (der Baum bewegt sich, Look!) → going to.
aufgabe.kontext: It's very windy, and the old tree in our garden is moving a lot.

aufgabe.anweisung: Ordne jedem Satzanfang das passende Ende zu.
loesungen: Look at those black clouds over the lake – it's going to rain any minute. | I don't know the new girl, but I think she'll be nice. | Jack is always late, so he will probably miss the bus again. | We've learned a lot, so I don't think the test will be very hard.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Anzeichen (Look at …) → going to; Vermutung (I think, probably, I don't think) → will.

paare.rechts: it's going to rain any minute.

paare.links: I don't know the new girl, but I think
Jack is always late, so he
paare.rechts: will probably miss the bus again.

paare.links: We've learned a lot, so I don't think the test

aufgabe.anweisung: Welche Form passt in die Lücke? Sortiere die Sätze.
loesungen: will (Meinung, Vermutung): I'm sure you ___ love the new film., Maybe Grandpa ___ visit us in May., I don't think the shop ___ be open on Sunday., Ella is very fast, so she ___ probably win. | going to (Anzeichen, Plan): Watch out! The cat ___ jump on the table., Look at Jack's face! He ___ be sick., We've already bought the paint. We ___ paint my room.
aufgabe.erklaerung: I'm sure, maybe, I don't think, probably → will; Watch out!, Look at … und ein schon gefasster Plan → going to.

elemente.text: I'm sure you ___ love the new film.
Watch out! The cat ___ jump on the table.
Maybe Grandpa ___ visit us in May.
Look at Jack's face! He ___ be sick.
We've already bought the paint. We ___ paint my room.
I don't think the shop ___ be open on Sunday.
Ella is very fast, so she ___ probably win.

aufgabe.anweisung: Wähle die richtige Form.
aufgabe.satz: I don't think it ___ easy, but let's try.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Nach I don't think steht will ohne not – sonst wäre es doppelt verneint.

aufgabe.anweisung: Ist der Satz richtig oder falsch? Wenn er falsch ist, berichtige das falsche Wort.
aufgabe.satz: I'm sure the new teacher will is friendly.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Falsch: Nach will steht die Grundform be, nicht is.

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze die Vorhersage mit will ein.
aufgabe.satz: I don't think Dad ___ my new hair. It's green!
aufgabe.erklaerung: Nach I don't think steht will ohne not: will like.

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze will, probably und das Verb ein.
aufgabe.satz: It's the last Saturday before Christmas, so the shops ___ very busy.
aufgabe.erklaerung: probably steht nach will: will probably be.

aufgabe.anweisung: Stelle die passende Frage mit will.
aufgabe.satz: I think the film will finish at about nine.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Frage mit will: When + will + Subjekt + Grundform?

aufgabe.anweisung: Meinung oder Anzeichen? Setze will oder going to mit dem Verb ein.
aufgabe.satz: His uncle says, "I'm sure you ___ it."
aufgabe.erklaerung: Kein Anzeichen, nur eine Meinung (I'm sure) → will love.
aufgabe.kontext: Ryan has never been to a football match. Tomorrow his uncle wants to take him to one.

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze will oder going to mit dem Verb ein. Meinung/Vermutung (I think, probably) → will; Anzeichen oder Plan → going to.
aufgabe.satz: Mia and her dad are at the station. They ___ (visit) Grandma today – they bought the tickets last week. Mia is very excited. "I think Grandma ___ (make) her famous apple cake," she says. Then Dad looks up. Black clouds are coming, and the wind is very strong. "Oh no, it ___ (rain)," he says. "Never mind," says Mia. "Grandma ___ (probably / not / want) to go for a walk anyway."
loesungen: are going to visit | will make | is going to rain | probably won't want
aufgabe.erklaerung: Plan (Tickets schon gekauft) und Anzeichen (Wolken) → going to; Vermutung (I think, probably) → will.

aufgabe.anweisung: Anzeichen oder Meinung? Wähle die passende Form.
aufgabe.satz: Look at Oscar! He ___ them!
aufgabe.erklaerung: Man sieht das Anzeichen schon jetzt (Look at Oscar!) → going to.
aufgabe.kontext: Oscar is carrying five glasses, and he isn't looking where he's going.

aufgabe.anweisung: Finde das falsche Wort und berichtige es.
aufgabe.satz: Don't worry about the trip – I think you will enjoying it.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Nach will steht die Grundform: will enjoy.
